title: Figure 50: imaginary acoustic pressure contours at 10,000 Hz, radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the imaginary component of pressure (Pa) for 10,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25. Fine ring structure near the source; legend -5178 to 3368 Pa. From the BAASS underwater acoustic propagation study.
